title: Gold Trim Prevents Piglin Aggro
description: Prevents Piglins from attacking players wearing gold trim.
body:
This datapack reduces Piglin vision to 0 around players who are wearing armor with Gold trim of any style.  

Attacking a Piglin, mining gold nearby, opening chests, etc. will still draw Piglin aggro.
Attacking a Piglin twice will aggro all nearby Piglins.

Piglins will not barter with players wearing gold trim; Gold armor is required (still useful).

This has no effect on Piglin Brutes.

Requirements: Minecraft 26+

Bug Reports and Questions: https://discord.gg/QNR3xKuX
